request_user:
Fact: integration_means
What to find: Technical means for integrating the model (usage instructions, APIs, serving frameworks, prompt/chat format).
Card sections that often contain it: How to Use, Quickstart, Usage, Deployment

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Use with Hugging Face transformers (v4.51.0 or later) via AutoProcessor and Llama4ForConditionalGeneration, with processor.apply_chat_template for chat-format messages (text and image inputs) and model.generate; the card also points to the Llama cookbook for generation parameters and recipes.
quotes: Please, make sure you have transformers v4.51.0 installed, or upgrade using pip install -U transformers.
For more technical information about generation parameters and recipes for how to use Llama 4 in applications, please go here (https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-cookbook).
